title: Direct Manipulation improvement — raise criterion from 80 to 90+ (UX scoring matrix)
deliberation_reason: New track created per UX scoring matrix gap analysis; highest weight (12%) among lower-rated items. Multiple defensible approaches exist (drag initiation threshold, drop targeting, visual feedback, keyboard alternative). Must run OSD before committing to a cluster.

phase0.summary: Nominate the Direct Manipulation cluster(s) to improve. Candidates: (a) drag initiation threshold — reduce accidental drags, add press-delay or distance threshold, (b) drop targeting — improve drop zone visualization, snap-to-slot, clearer valid/invalid targets, (c) visual feedback during drag — ghost preview, section outline, page-break indicators, (d) keyboard alternative — full drag-reorder via keyboard (arrow keys + modifier), meeting accessibility requirements. Run OSD to pick one cluster for Phase 1.

phase1.summary: Implement the nominated Direct Manipulation improvement cluster. Likely extends js/dnd.js or js/controls_panel.js behind existing window.DND or window.Controls seam. Must pass: eslint clean, npm run lint, all existing unit tests (no regressions), dnd.test.js (33 cases) and controls_panel.test.js (63 cases) stay green.

phase2.summary: N/A unless new measured premise (e.g., drag latency metric validated).

phase3.summary: Guard-discipline continuity: injected-scope collision, dead-exports, scripts hygiene, full suite, lint, smoke — all green. Add Direct Manipulation regression test(s) for the new capability.

phase4.summary: Checkpoint + frontier review + consultant verification (3 consultants).

phase5.summary: Register, seal, hand-over. Target: Direct Manipulation criterion >= 90 on next UX scoring run.

context.gap_analysis: Highest weight (12%) among the lower-rated items. Drag-and-reorder in-sheet experience has friction: initiation threshold, drop targeting, visual feedback during drag, keyboard alternative.
context.fleet_certification: ux_feature_fleet_20261029 completed 18/18 tracks; track-03 (controls) at 153e2df, track-04 (dnd) at f167c3f
context.handoff_instructions: Fresh session: read this spec + matrix.json + dnd.test.js + controls_panel.test.js + js/dnd.js + js/controls_panel.js. Run OSD (subspace-deliberation skill) to nominate Phase 1 cluster. Then execute Phase 1 improvement per conductor-protocol.

criteria_note: Draft track: acceptance criteria live in spec.md as [AC-1]..[AC-4] and are NOT sealed. Seal at Phase 5 with `python housekeeping_guard.py seal --track direct_manipulation_improvement_20261103`.
